name: LoLA: Low-Rank Linear Attention with Sparse Caching.
description: LoLA: Low-Rank Linear Attention with Sparse Caching.  Combines factorized low-rank projections with selective multi-system cached retrieval, trainable LoRA residual adapters, frozen SVD base weights, GQA, RoPE, and causal decoding.
math_latex: W \approx U V, \quad U \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{\text{out}} \times r}, \; V \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{\text{in}}}

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
